lines.text: The Servant says the LORD called Him from the womb and hid Him in His quiver like a polished arrow.
The LORD calls Him His Servant, Israel, but He says He has labored in vain, yet His reward is with His God.
The LORD says it is not enough to raise up the tribes of Jacob, so He will make His Servant a light for the nations.
To the One despised by the nation, the LORD says kings will see Him and rise, and priests will bow down.
People will come from far away, from the north and from the west, and from the land of Sinai.
